title: URL Shortener
subtitle: Reads outnumber writes ten to one, so a cache carries it until a link goes viral
motto: Put the whole loop to work on one small, read-heavy system
coreAddition: cache in front of the database, then read replicas
keyInsight: Turn the requirements into reads per second first: a cache takes a 1,200-reads-a-second peak down to a database load of 23%, but a 10x viral spike still overloads one node, so replicas and the 301 or 302 choice are decisions to price, not defaults.

decisions.title: Start with the no-cache load
decisions.description: The first frame sends every read to one database node to show the requirement alone already exceeds it, so the cache is justified by a number.
decisions.alternatives: Starting from the finished design would hide why each component is there.

decisions.title: Fail at a viral spike, not at steady load
decisions.description: The failure frame multiplies reads 10x with the cache hit rate unchanged, because a cache that works on average still passes the misses to a database that cannot take them.
decisions.alternatives: Testing only average traffic would call the v1 design finished.

decisions.title: 302 redirects with replicas
decisions.description: Every click reaches the servers so analytics stay complete, and read replicas pay for the extra load.
decisions.alternatives: A 301 redirect lets browsers cache it and removes load, but the clicks it hides are lost from analytics.
